title: The next step
text: What would you do next if you had another month for this project?

options.response: 方向可能合理，但需要说明为什么以及收集什么。

options.text: I would test the weakest assumption first, using a small independent sample, before adding more features.
options.response: 下一步与现有记录的薄弱环节相连，安排有优先级。

options.text: I would make every part much better.
options.response: 目标过于笼统，无法判断一个月内怎样推进。
